common.noFieldsBody: Add your fields (area, soil type and location) in Settings. Weather, irrigation and fertilizer advice are calculated per field.

weather.title: Weather
weather.subtitle: 7-day forecast, the next 48 hours and farm advisories for your location.
weather.noAdvisories: No weather warnings for the next few days.
weather.et0Help: ET0 is the FAO-56 reference evapotranspiration: how much water a well-watered grass field loses per day. Crop water need = Kc × ET0.
weather.stale: Showing the last forecast received at {{time}}; the weather service cannot be reached right now.
weather.staleShort: The weather service cannot be reached; an older forecast is used.
weather.noLocation: Your farm location is not set
weather.noLocationBody: Add your location to your profile or to a field in Settings to see the forecast.
weather.unavailableBody: The weather service cannot be reached right now. Please try again later.

advisories.rain_48h: About {{mm}} mm of rain expected in the next 48 hours: postpone spraying, irrigation and fertilizer top-dressing.
advisories.wind_spray: Wind up to {{kmh}} km/h in the next 24 hours: avoid spraying (drift).
advisories.heavy_rain: Heavy rain ({{mm}} mm) expected on {{date}}: clear field drains and protect harvested produce.
advisories.heat: Maximum temperature of {{c}} °C expected on {{date}}: irrigate in the early morning or evening and avoid midday spraying.
advisories.cold: Minimum temperature of {{c}} °C expected on {{date}}: risk of cold injury to sensitive crops.
advisories.dry_week: Only {{mm}} mm of rain expected this week: check the irrigation page for your fields.

rules.rain_48h: forecast rain in the next 48 h ≥ 10 mm (TerraByte rule of thumb, not an official threshold).
rules.wind_spray: hourly wind above 15 km/h in the next 24 h (common pesticide-label guidance).
rules.heavy_rain: a day with ≥ 64.5 mm of rain (IMD 'heavy rainfall').
rules.heat: a day with a maximum of ≥ 40 °C (IMD plains threshold for considering a heat wave).
rules.cold: a day with a minimum of ≤ 4 °C (IMD cold-wave criterion for plains).
rules.dry_week: less than 2.5 mm of rain in 7 days (below IMD 'light rain').

irrigation.title: Irrigation
irrigation.subtitle: Crop water need from the FAO-56 method (crop coefficient × evaporation) and a soil-water balance for each field.
irrigation.dailyHelp: All values in mm. Depletion = water used from the root zone since it was last full; irrigate when it reaches the readily available water (RAW).
irrigation.forField: About {{litres}} litres for this field ({{acres}} acres), before losses in pipes or channels.
irrigation.params: FAO-56 crop: {{name}}. Kc initial {{ini}}, mid {{mid}}, end {{end}}. Stage lengths {{stages}} days (FAO row: {{region}}). Maximum root depth {{root}} m, depletion fraction p {{p}}.
irrigation.proxy: FAO-56 has no values for this crop; a similar crop is used as a stand-in.

totals.effectiveRain: Rain stored in the root zone

rec.today: Irrigate today: about {{mm}} mm (≈ {{litres}} litres per acre).
rec.in_days: Irrigate in about {{days}} days: about {{mm}} mm (≈ {{litres}} litres per acre).
rec.not_within_window: No irrigation needed in the next 7 days if the forecast holds.
rec.not_applicable: Paddy is kept flooded, so this soil-water check does not apply. See the water use figures below.

status.no_crop: No crop set for this field
status.unknown_crop: This crop name is not recognised
status.not_available: Not available for this crop yet

statusBody.no_crop: Choose the crop and sowing date for this field in Crop planning.
statusBody.unknown_crop: Choose the crop from the list in Crop planning so its water need can be calculated.
statusBody.not_available: FAO-56 has no reliable water-use values for this crop (for example tur, okra, pomegranate, gram or double-pruned grapes). Ask your KVK for local guidance.
statusBody.no_sowing_date: Enter the sowing (or transplanting) date in Crop planning.
statusBody.not_sown: The sowing date is in the future.
statusBody.season_over: The FAO-56 season length for this crop has passed since sowing. Update the crop plan for the next season.

assumptions.soil_texture_mapped: Soil water holding is taken from the field's soil type ({{awc}} mm per metre, FAO-56 Table 19 midpoint). Choose the soil texture above if you know it.
assumptions.soil_default: The field's soil type is unknown, so loam ({{awc}} mm per metre) is assumed. Choose the soil texture above.
assumptions.start_fc_window: The root zone is assumed to be full (field capacity) on {{date}}, 7 days ago. Enter the last irrigation date for a better estimate.
assumptions.start_fc_sowing: The root zone is assumed to be full at sowing ({{date}}).
assumptions.start_fc_last_irrigation: The root zone is assumed to be full after the last irrigation (from {{date}}).
assumptions.last_irrigation_before_window: The last irrigation is more than 7 days ago; only the last 7 days are counted, starting full.
assumptions.runoff_zero: Runoff is not modelled: rain beyond what the root zone can hold is counted as lost to deep percolation. Heavy rain on slopes may be less useful than shown.
assumptions.small_rain_ignored: Rain below 0.2 × ET0 on a day is treated as evaporated (FAO-56).
assumptions.kc_not_climate_adjusted: Kc values are FAO-56 table values, not adjusted for local wind and humidity.
assumptions.fao_stage_lengths: Stage lengths are FAO-56 example values, not your variety's exact duration.
assumptions.net_not_gross: Amounts are net water at the root zone; add losses of your irrigation method (drip loses less than flood).

soil.title: Soil & fertilizer
soil.subtitle: Enter your Soil Health Card values to get a fertilizer dose based on the state agricultural university's recommendation.
soil.formHint: Copy the values from your Soil Health Card or lab report. Leave a box empty if it is not on the card.

scheme.mpkv: Rated with the MPKV Rahuri 6-class table (Krishi Darshani 2026): very low +50%, low +25%, medium / moderately high as recommended, high −25%, very high −50%.
scheme.national: Rated with the national 3-class table (Methods Manual 2011); dose rule from the SHC manual 2023: low +25%, medium as recommended, high −25%.

fert.chooseCrop: Choose a crop to see the recommended dose.
fert.noRdf: No usable recommended dose for this crop yet
fert.noRdfBody: The official sources we have give this crop's dose per plant or with conflicting units. Follow your Soil Health Card or ask your KVK.

reasons.conflict_flagged: units in the source conflict; verify before use
reasons.per_plant: dose is given per plant, not per area
reasons.no_numbers: the source gives no N-P-K numbers

fert.disclaimerTitle: Follow your Soil Health Card / local agriculture officer
fert.disclaimer: This is a calculation from published recommendations, not a field visit. Your Soil Health Card, KVK or agriculture officer may advise differently for your soil, variety and season.

notes.no_soil_test: No soil test selected: this is the general recommended dose, not adjusted for your soil.
notes.missing_nutrients: Some nutrients were not on the soil test; those use the recommended dose without adjustment.

fert.pBasisNote: P and K are rated as elemental P and K (P₂O₅ ÷ 2.29, K₂O ÷ 1.2046). The MPKV table does not say which basis it uses; its limits match the 2011 Maharashtra P₂O₅/K₂O table after this conversion.
fert.fym: Also apply farmyard manure: {{t}} tonnes per hectare (as given in the source).

carrierHelp.dap: All phosphate from DAP, potash from MOP, the rest of the nitrogen from urea.
carrierHelp.ssp: All phosphate from SSP (also gives sulphur), potash from MOP, nitrogen from urea.
carrierHelp.npk_10_26_26: All phosphate from 10:26:26, extra potash from MOP, the rest of the nitrogen from urea.
carrierHelp.npk_12_32_16: All phosphate from 12:32:16, extra potash from MOP, the rest of the nitrogen from urea.
carrierHelp.aps_20_20_0_13: All phosphate from 20:20:0:13, potash from MOP, the rest of the nitrogen from urea.

fert.excess: This product also supplies {{kg}} kg/acre more {{nutrient}} than needed.
fert.priceNote: Prices only for products with a government-fixed or reported price; other products are priced by the company (printed on the bag). Price sources:
fert.noSplit: The source does not give a split schedule for this entry; ask your agriculture officer how to split the dose.
fert.microDeficient: {{nutrient}}: {{value}} ppm — below the critical limit of {{limit}} ppm (deficient)
fert.microOk: {{nutrient}}: {{value}} ppm — above the critical limit of {{limit}} ppm
fert.microAdvice: For deficient micronutrients, MPKV recommends its micronutrient grade with farmyard manure; ask your KVK for the product and dose.

plan.title: Crop planning
plan.subtitle: Sowing windows, duration, seed rate and spacing for your region from the state agricultural universities and ICAR, with the MSP where one exists.
plan.myFieldsHint: The crop, season and sowing date are used by Irrigation and Soil & fertilizer.
plan.freeText: Current entry "{{crop}}" is not in the crop list; choose a crop to use the calculators.
plan.noMsp: No MSP for this crop: prices are set by the market.
plan.noIrrigationData: Irrigation calculator not available for this crop yet.

schemes.title: Government schemes & MSP
schemes.subtitle: Central and Maharashtra schemes for farmers, from official sources, and the latest minimum support prices.

statusHelp.changed: Terms have changed recently or an announced change is not yet confirmed. Check before applying.
statusHelp.closed: This scheme is no longer accepting applications.
statusHelp.unverified: Its current status could not be confirmed from an official source. Check with the office before applying.

schemes.englishNote: Scheme details are shown in English as published by the government; names are translated.
schemes.more: Eligibility, documents and how to apply

msp.notGuaranteed: MSP is the price at which government agencies buy fair-average-quality produce when they run procurement. Whether your crop is bought at MSP in your district or mandi depends on procurement operations.
msp.frpLine: Sugar season {{season}}: {{price}} per quintal at {{recovery}}% basic recovery.
msp.notesTitle: Crops without MSP and other notes
msp.noMspCrops: Most vegetables (onion, tomato, potato…), fruits, spices and flowers have no MSP; their prices are set by the market.
